name: Lost to Legend
oracle_text: Put target nonland historic permanent into its owner's library fourth from the top. (Artifacts, legendaries, and Sagas are historic.)
blocked_sentences: Put target nonland historic permanent into its owner's library fourth from the top.

needs.what: A way to put an object into a library at a stated depth from the top -- either a new op (`put_into_library` with `objects`, `from_top: {"const": 4}`) or a `from_top`/`depth` amount on the existing `put_on_top`, plumbed through `move_object` as an insert index instead of the current top/bottom boolean. Depth should be an amount from `value_keys` (so `{"const": 2}` covers Hinder and `{"const": 4}` covers this card), it must clamp to the end of a library shorter than the depth, and the destination player must stay the object's *owner*, not the controller, since the printed line says "its owner's library".
needs.why_existing_wont_do: `put_on_top` is the only op that sends a permanent to a library, and it hard-codes the destination: `move_object(..., Zone.LIBRARY, to_player=obj.owner, to_top=True, cause="tuck")` in src/automtg/engine/effects/ops_cards.py, with no depth or position in the spec it reads. `move_object` itself (src/automtg/engine/zones.py) only accepts `to_top: bool = False`, so top and bottom are the sole reachable positions -- there is no insert index anywhere in the zone layer. Nothing else composes into a fourth-from-top tuck either: `scry`, `surveil` and `look_at_top` reorder or relocate cards that are *already* in a library and cannot admit a permanent from the battlefield, and `shuffle` randomizes rather than places. Approximating with plain `put_on_top` is a strictly better card than the one printed -- the owner draws the permanent back next turn instead of in four turns, which inverts the whole point of the depth -- and approximating with a bottom-of-library tuck is strictly worse and effectively exile in a 99-card deck.

notes: Only the depth blocks this card; the rest of the line needs nothing new. "Target nonland historic permanent" is already expressible in the selector language as {"zone": "battlefield", "not_types": ["Land"], "any_of": [{"types": ["Artifact"]}, {"supertypes": ["Legendary"]}, {"subtypes": ["Saga"]}]} -- `any_of` is a union of whole sub-selectors (selectors.py `matches`), so it ORs the three historic readings correctly, including artifact creatures and legendary lands-excluded-by-not_types. Once the depth exists the card is a one-op `spell_effects` instant, and the sandbox position gives it a legal target (the opponent's artifact), so the expectation can assert {"zone": "graveyard", "opponent_battlefield_count": 5}.
